items.name: Can 'Em All

items.name: A Place for Every Potion

items.name: COP BASTARD
items.desc: COP BASTARD is a classic FPS set in early ’90s Japan. Play as a tough detective and blast through waves of yakuza in relentless action inspired by ’90s films. No puzzles, perks or upgrades - just corridors, enemies and the chance to spit in their faces.

items.line: 12회차 연속 · 승격 통과 · 12회차 오가닉 · New & Trending 86위 · 리뷰 1,176(+25) · 7일 +339 · 동접 758(−4.3%) · $2.49
items.desc: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

items.name: How to Fish
items.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

items.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
items.desc: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

items.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs
items.desc: Run a quaint electronics repair shop in mid-2000s Tokyo. Grow your business by carefully restoring iconic video game consoles, cell phones, music players, and other nostalgic devices. Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

items.name: Galvatein : Adventurers' Guild
items.desc: "Welcome, adventurer! What quest have you completed today?” A classic fantasy guild reception simulation — 『Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild』

items.name: DRAPLINE
items.desc: "DRAPLINE" is a roguelite training game where you raise a dragon girl who eats anything and train her to become the strongest in one year. Feed her a variety of things to increase her abilities, combine various skills to build your own strategy, and defeat the impending catastrophe!

items.name: TBH: Task Bar Hero
items.sub: Nugem Studio · Casual, RPG, Free To Play
items.desc: The ultimate tiny idle RPG! Adorable pixel heroes are waiting to join your adventure — from your taskbar. Fight off the boredom of work and daily life with diverse classes, skills, items, and builds!

items.name: DUNGEON SLASHER
items.desc: Navigate maps filled with enemies, destroying all who get in your way! Use a variety of character, artifact, and skill synergies to defeat the dungeon!

items.name: Escape From Duckov
items.desc: Escape from Duckov is a PVE indie survival RPG — in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.

items.name: Servant of the Lake
items.desc: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.

items.name: Supermarket Chaos
items.desc: Supermarket Chaos is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 4,668 products in a messy supermarket. Enjoy the satisfaction of stocking shelves in a calm, relaxing atmosphere.

items.name: Beat For Speed
items.desc: Turn any song into a playable rhythm ride! Import your favorite music or play along with your device's audio in Live Audio Mode. Discover official tracks from indie artists, climb the leaderboards, create custom levels in the Level Editor, and explore endless community levels on Steam Workshop.

items.name: Crime Scene Cleaner
items.desc: Once you get tangled with the mob, you will forever be a part of the mob. At least they pay a decent salary and all you have to do is clean up after their dirty work, but you know what you’re doing. So clean crime scenes, earn as much money as you can, and get ready for the next mission.

items.name: Tiny Eden
items.desc: A cozy first-person farming sim, set in the heart of a futuristic city. Grow plants, cook what you harvest, and discover new varieties as you turn your apartment into a thriving urban garden, from a small balcony to a rooftop paradise.

items.name: 1.44MB RESCUE
items.desc: Write Python-style code to program repair patchers and rescue a corrupting 1.44MB floppy sector by sector. Start with four commands; every file you restore unlocks loops, variables, functions and lists, until your programs bring all 1,474,560 bytes back to life. The whole game fits on one floppy.

items.name: rest: in a dark room
items.desc: Two misanthropic teenagers attempt to be reborn through the world of sensory deprivation. A visual novel full of death, drugs, and dolphins.

items.name: NIGHTWARD
items.desc: Your mother was a night nurse. A month after her funeral, a hospital closed for twelve years calls your phone. Follow her route through Sislidere, one sealed building at a time, and learn who was kept awake there - and why. Some of them only move when you look away.

items.name: Circuit Pulse
items.desc: Circuit Pulse is a circuit puzzle game. Route glowing energy through cables and components on a board. Split, merge, and time pulses to power targets and trigger chain reactions across a board of escalating challenges.

items.name: ERLIK
items.sub: Ash & Antler · Action, RPG, Early Access
items.desc: A survivors-like rooted in Turkic mythology. Every run drifts between two gods: feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal.
